description:
Experience luxury riverside living in this beautifully furnished dual-aspect apartment located on one of the upper floors of the prestigious Ambassador Building, Embassy Gardens.This exceptional home enjoys breathtaking views of the River Thames and London’s skyline.

The spacious open-plan reception room is perfect for entertaining, featuring a sleek modern integrated kitchen and access to a stylish winter garden – the ideal spot to relax and enjoy the views all year round. Both bedrooms are generously proportioned, with the principal suite offering an elegant en suite bathroom. A second luxury bathroom, good storage, and a utility cupboard complete the layout. Secure parking is available by separate negotiation.

World-Class Resident Amenities
Embassy Gardens offers some of the finest facilities in London, including:

    24-hour concierge

    Private cinema screening room, library & lounge

    Business centre & yoga studio

    Two fully equipped gyms

    Heated indoor/outdoor swimming pool

    Exclusive access to the world-famous Sky Pool, suspended between two towers

Lifestyle & Location
Enjoy on-site dining and lifestyle venues such as District Coffee Shop, Darby’s Restaurant, The Alchemist, Homeboy bars, and a Waitrose convenience store. Beyond the development, you’re just minutes from the vibrant shopping and dining at Battersea Power Station.

Exceptional Transport Links

    Nine Elms Tube station – less than a 5-minute walk

    Vauxhall station – walking distance, with Underground, Overground & National Rail services

    Easy access into Central London, the West End, and beyond

Council Tax Band: G (London Borough of Wandsworth)
keyFeatures: Stylish open-plan reception with modern integrated kitchen
Two luxury bathrooms, including en suite to principal bedroom
Furnished to a high standard with excellent storage & utility cupboard
24-hour concierge, library, cinema, and business centre
Two private residents’ gyms, yoga studio & heated indoor/outdoor pool
Exclusive access to the iconic Sky Pool
On-site dining & retail including Waitrose, Darby’s, The Alchemist & more
Less than 5 minutes’ walk to Nine Elms Tube & close to Vauxhall Station
Short walk to Battersea Power Station shops, restaurants & bars
